name: Rukawa Haruto
source:
“We'll take the front line. You handle the rear.
This is a position we can't afford to yield.”

Unit: Security Blue, 2nd Squad

A squad member operating under Alhena.

He's germophobic and easily flustered, but remains unwaveringly dutiful in his work.
